import numpy as np
d=np.load("showcase.npz")
X,y,classes=d["X"],d["y"],d["classes"]
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
tr,te=train_test_split(np.arange(len(X)),test_size=.25,random_state=42,stratify=y)
means=np.stack([X[tr][y[tr]==c].mean(axis=0) for c in range(4)])
dist=((X[te,None].astype(float)-means[None])**2).sum(axis=(2,3))
centroid_acc=round(float((dist.argmin(axis=1)==y[te]).mean()),3)
fig,axs=plt.subplots(1,4)
for c,ax in enumerate(axs):
    ax.imshow(means[c],cmap="gray",vmin=0,vmax=255); ax.set_title(classes[c])
print(centroid_acc)

import numpy as np
d=np.load("showcase.npz")
X,y,classes=d["X"],d["y"],d["classes"]
X=X.astype(float)
i=np.flatnonzero(y==1)[0]
x0=X[i]
d_shift={k:round(float(np.linalg.norm(x0-np.roll(x0,k,axis=1)))) for k in range(1,7)}
d_same=round(float(np.mean([np.linalg.norm(x0-z) for j,z in enumerate(X) if y[j]==1 and j!=i])))
d_empty=round(float(np.mean([np.linalg.norm(x0-z) for z in X[y==0]])))
max_safe_shift=max([k for k,v in d_shift.items() if v<d_empty],default=0)
print(d_shift,d_same,d_empty,max_safe_shift)
expect: Шесть расстояний в исходных уровнях яркости, средние расстояния до других круассанов и пустых; safe сравнивает с d_empty.
